anna: Heads-up: I noticed the API reference for POST /v1/generate has several JSON examples with numbers wrapped in quotes (e.g. "temperature": "0.5"). This caused a user report where the TypeScript playground flagged type errors. Filed PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4928

sam: Oof, thanks. Where are the examples?

anna: Under docs/reference/generate.md and docs/snippets/generate_examples.md. Both have the same problem; the TS snippet also uses a loose `any` type around the payload which hid the issue.

kai: I can update the TS snippet to import the typed interface and switch the JSON literals to real numbers. Also will replace the inline compact JSON with a pretty-printed example for readability.
notes: Small, realistic Slack thread; includes PR link, CI mention, and action items. Follow-up commits: TS fix, docs fix, CI validation of examples. No title field included per agents.md.
